# Roleplay Rule 13 ## Get Yarr Loot Lads!
This rule is intended to fill holes and alleviate confusion when it comes to how pirates are to be played and what they are allowed and not allowed to do.
As a pirate you are expected to maintain your ship and your crew health while following your captains orders
A pirate captain is expected to minimize the casualty rate of their own crew as well as NT and Freelancer crews. You want booze money and power, but unnecessary violence and escalation is out of the question especially when it comes to murder.
Pirates are expected to state their intentions when boarding a hostile or neutral ship. You may not lie about this intention under false pretenses to gain an unfair advantage when boarding.
In the event shuttle combat has escalated from EMP weaponry to destructive weapons, pirates are to confirm the origin of the taken structural damage before using their own destructive weapons in retaliation.
This rule does not impede reasonable escalation from the security team attempting to enforce Space Law.
## Examples Acceptable: - Firing EMP weaponry at Station and Shuttle to prevent your target from escaping - Boarding Stations and Ships for the purpose of stealing material goods - Stealing Station and Ship loot in the form of weapons, drinks, and resources such as diamonds, gold, silver, uranium - Using destructive weaponry in self defense from hostile engaging ships such as Lbyte Mbyte ships - Kidnapping Ship crews to hold for randsome - Executing a Security team member for boarding your ship
Prohibited: - Major destruction of NT Stations and Ships - Major destruction of Freelancer Stations and Ships - Unnessisary Round Removal or Murder of a Freelancer or member of their crew - Escalating first to destructive weapons durring ship combat - Theft of NT Station or NukeOps nuke - Failing to warn a ship you are boarding for the intent of stealing goods - Stealing everything a Ship/shuttle has
